## Description

Maps hierarchical supply chain networks and market sector taxonomies into non-Euclidean hyperbolic space to capture structural scale-free market dependencies for cross-sectional stock return prediction.

## Where it may fit

Broad cross-sectional equity universes (e.g. S&P 500 / Russell 3000), contagion and supply-chain shock propagation.

## Vehicles

Quantitative equity hedge funds, systematic long/short factor funds.

## Required data

Stock fundamental factor panels, supply-chain relational graphs, historical price time series.

## Caveats

Hyperbolic gradient descent requires Riemannian optimization optimizers and numerical stability checks.
